# Synthetic video fixtures

Small, synthetic elementary streams for camera, recorder, live and restream tests. They are
generated by ffmpeg running in a pinned Docker image (never a host install) from the
`testsrc2` pattern, so they contain no real footage.

| File | Codec | Size | Rate | Length | GOP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `h264-640x360-gop2-10s.h264` | H.264 High, Annex-B | 640x360 | 15 fps | 150 frames (10 s) | IDR every 30 frames (2 s) |
| `h265-640x360-gop2-5s.h265` | H.265 Main, Annex-B | 640x360 | 15 fps | 75 frames (5 s) | IDR every 30 frames (2 s) |

Properties the tests rely on:

* Closed GOPs: keyframes are IDR (H.264 type 5, H.265 IDR_W_RADL/IDR_N_LP), at frames
  0, 30, 60, ... only (`-sc_threshold 0` / `scenecut=0`, `min-keyint` equal to `keyint`).
* No B-frames, so decode order equals presentation order (as on Tapo cameras) and the test
  RTSP server can stamp RTP times as `start + i*90000/fps`.
* Parameter sets (VPS/SPS/PPS) are repeated in-band before every IDR.

Regenerate with:

```sh
testdata/video/gen.sh
```

Both files must stay under 2 MiB. Load them in tests with `testutil.LoadAnnexB(t, path)`
and serve them with `testutil.StartRTSPServer`.
